|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. When your character is lost from table, place all Effects and Devices on that character into owner's Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲an Effect or Device that deploys on a character.[Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner’s Used Pile. Twice per game, may take a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “When” → “If”; added “about to be”; added “devices and”; removed “and Devices”; “into owner's” → “in owner’s”; “▲an Effect or Device” → “take a device (or an Effect)”; “character.[Immune” → “character into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 21. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Rycar Ryjerd]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
